findings.evidence: `cohomologyClass_factorSet_eq` at lines 293–296 compares two sections of the same `S`, while `nonempty_groupExtensionEquiv_of_cohomologyClass_eq` at lines 241–244 proves only equal class → equivalent extensions.
findings.fix: Either add the theorem that extension equivalences preserve the class and state the resulting iff, or weaken all three passages to the directions actually proved.
findings.issue: The module docstring calls the class a complete classification of extensions (repeated at lines 34–35 and 291–292), but the cited results only prove section-independence, representation by a factor-set extension, and that equal classes imply equivalent extensions; no converse invariance under `GroupExtension.Equiv` is stated.

summary: The documentation overstates the proved extension classification: it does not establish that equivalent extensions have equal cohomology classes.
